## Import data

```{r}
### Load plotting function from "functions.R"

```

### Plot Stock overview

```{r}
plot_overview <- plot_herring_summary(
  srr_data = Herring_full,
  ssb_col = "SSB",
  recruit_col = "Recruitment",
  year_col = "year",
  f_col = "F")


ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "overview.png"),

       bg = "white",
       width = 10,
       height = 20,
       dpi = 300)
```

# Change-points

## Identify change-points

```{r}
### cpt analysis
results_cpt <- changepoint_analysis(Herring_full, 
                                          region_name = "Full Stock",
                                          year_col = "year",
                                          Q = 6,
                                          bcp_threshold = 0.5,
                                          ssb_col = "SSB")
# CPT changepoint indices:  4,    16,   18,   34,   37,   51 
# CPT changepoint years:    1950, 1964, 1966, 1986, 2000, 2018 

## BCP Analysis
# BCP changepoint indices:  20,   37,   54 
# BCP changepoint years:    1966, 1983, 2000 

## Consensus Analysis
# Consensus changepoints (± 1 yr, min 5 yr apart): 1966, 2000 
# CPT only: 1950, 1964, 1986, 2018 
# BCP only: 1983  
```

## Plot Change-points

```{r}
### Call function plot_SSB_cpt
plot_SSB_cpt_full <- plot_SSB_cpt(data = Herring_full,
              changepoints = c(1966, 1986,2000), 
              ribbon_colors = c("#201124", "#3e478d", "grey", "#318ca5"),
              vline_colors = c("black", "grey", "black"),
              component = "Full Stock", 
              SSB_column = "SSB", 
              l_bnd_column = "l_bnd", 
              u_bnd_column = "u_bnd", 
              show_hlines = TRUE)
plot_SSB_cpt_full
```

### Save plots

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SSB_cpt_full.png"),
       plot = plot_SSB_cpt_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 10,
       height = 7,
       dpi = 300)
```

# Hysteresis

## Analysis

```{r}
### Check for time-lags
ccf(Herring_full$SSB[-(79:78)], Herring_full$F[-(79:78)], type = "correlation") # 3 years lag
Herring_full$SSB_lag <- lag(Herring_full$SSB, 3)

### Call "breakpoint_analysis" function
results_brkpt <- breakpoint_analysis(Herring_full, "SSB", "F", "year",
                                    lag_years = 3, 
                                    region_name = "Full Stock")

# Optimal number of breaks: 4 
# Best breakpoint F values:
# 0.25  1.43  0.43  0.22 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1960, 1971, 1986, 2000 
```

## Plotting

```{r}
### Call function plot_hysteresis
plot_hysteresis_full <- plot_hysteresis(Herring_full, results_brkpt$break_years, "Full Stock")
plot_hysteresis_full
```

### save plot

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "hysteresis_full.png"),
       plot = plot_hysteresis_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 10,
       height = 7,
       dpi = 300)
```

# SRR Non-Stationary

## Analysis

```{r}
### Run model comparison from model_comp_functions.R 
source("R/model_comp_functions.R")

models_SRR <- run_srr_analysis(
  data_for_srr = Herring_full,
  recruit_col = "Recruitment", 
  ssb_col = "SSB",
  max_breaks = 4,
  use_bic = TRUE)

print(models_SRR$comparison_table)
#               Model          AIC     RMSE  R_squared
#        independence 2.777474e+03 12571251 0.07056036
#       beverton_holt 12160648 0.17631638
#              ricker 1.113423e+02 12369273 0.15890238
#   segmented_regular 2.760880e+03 11016520 0.28623866
#       segmented_log 9.301744e+01 29027744 0.60192295
#  segmented_negbinom 2.741850e+03 11015926         NA
#         strucchange 2.729688e+03  8791700 0.54542040
#        glm_gaussian 2.777474e+03 12571251         NA
#         glm_poisson 5.007045e+08 12644111         NA
#    glm_quasipoisson           NA 12644111         NA
#        glm_negbinom 2.777921e+03 12705255

#### strucchange lowest RMSE.

### Prep data for LOOCV function
dat <- Herring_full %>%
  mutate(R_log = log(Recruitment),
         SSB_log = log(SSB)) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, Recruitment, SSB, R_log, SSB_log) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  setNames(c("Year", "R", "SSB", "R_log", "SSB_log")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

### Call function "cross_valid" for performing loocv for all models
rmse_mean_herring <- cross_valid(dataset = dat)
#         linear    beverton    ricker      segmented   seg.log     segm.glm    strucchange
# TEST:   10164856  9080981     10040655    9437569     9475234     9394538     12472272
# TRAIN:  12568771  12158586    12366932    11012203    11184582    11014417    8777879

#### strucchange validated by loocv.

### Call function "srr_breakpoint_analysis"
results_SRR <- srr_breakpoint_analysis(Herring_full, "SSB", "Recruitment", "year", "Herring Full")

# Optimal number of breaks: 2 
# Best breakpoint SSB values:
# 264793.8, 2391903.7 
# Best breakpoint years:
# 1981, 2002 
```

## Plotting

```{r}
plot_SRR_full <- plot_SRR(Herring_full, break_years = results_SRR$break_years, "Full Stock", "strucchange")
plot_SRR_full
```

#### save plot

```{r}
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/", "SRR_full.png"),
       plot = plot_SRR_full,
       bg = "white",
       width = 10,
       height = 7,
       dpi = 300)
```

# tGAM

```{r}
### Load env data
load("data/env_df_full.Rdata")

### Call "run_threshold_analysis" from functions and extract results (below)
results_tgam <- run_threshold_analysis(Herring_full, env_df_full, 
                       aggregation_mode = "all", 
                       test_variables = c("Mean_SST", "Mean_SSS"))

# results_tgam[["summary_tables"]][["year"]]
#   Variable  n edf_before edf_after p_value_min Threshold Threshold_accepted
#   Mean_SST 64      0.667     0.993    4.51e-14      10.4    No tGAM (LOOCV)
#   Mean_SSS 64      0.667     0.000    2.56e-23      34.1    No tGAM (LOOCV)

# results_tgam[["summary_tables"]][["winter"]]
#   Variable  n edf_before edf_after p_value_min Threshold Threshold_accepted
#   Mean_SST 64      0.667     0.989    4.29e-11       7.1    No tGAM (LOOCV)
#   Mean_SSS 64      0.667     0.000    6.66e-21      34.3                Yes

#### SSS threshold accepted for larval overwintering.

png(filename = "plots/tGAM/SSS_Full_larv.png", width = 1500, height = 1000, res = 300)
plot_gcv_Banks_SST_autumn <- plot_gcv_threshold(results_tgam$winter$SSS, "SSS-Full Stock", "(Winter)")
dev.off()
#### Threshold confirmed by gcv valley.
```

## Plotting

```{r}
### Prep data for plotting
tgam_input <- Herring_full %>%
  dplyr::select(year, SSB, Recruitment) %>%
  left_join(
    env_df_full %>%
      filter(Season == "Winter") %>%
      dplyr::select(year, Mean_SSS),
    by = "year"
  ) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(SSB_lag = lag(SSB, n = 3)) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  arrange(SSB_lag) %>%
  rename(Year = year)

### Plot using "plot_tgam" from funtions
plot_tgam_full_larv <- plot_tgam_complete(tgam_input, threshold = 34.3, env_var = "Mean_SSS")

### save plot
ggsave(filename = file.path("plots/tGAM", "Full_SSS_larv.png"),
       plot = plot_tgam_full_larv,
       bg = "white",
       width = 10,
       height = 7,
       dpi = 300)
```
